d: Neeraj Kumar On Tejashwi Yadav : jediyu emaelsi niraj kumar ne pradhanmantri narendr modi ke bihar daure, chhah len pul aur raghopur ke vikas ko lekar bara bayan diya hai... unhonne kaha ki chhah len pul uttar aur dakshin bihar ko jorne ke sath rajy ke vikas men aham bhumika nibhaega... niraj kumar ke mutabik, raghopur ko naya bengluru banane ki taiyari hai aur iske vikas ke lie vishesh kameti banaee gaee hai...niraj kumar ne ilake men semikandaktar sahit vibhinn kshetron men nirman aur nivesh ka bhi jikr kiya... vahin, JDU-BJP ke bich vivad ke vipakshi aaropon ko unhonne 'chandukhane ki…
